files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.IMcapRecord
files.Summary: A record model. Results returned by are independently owned. Pattern match the concrete record type to access its fields. Unknown opcodes return ; no payload or collection borrows the input span.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapAsyncReader
files.Summary: One incremental asynchronous read session backed by the official Sans-I/O parser. Owns its Stream unless leaveOpen is true. Consume each ValueTask exactly once before another operation; I/O, parsing and cancellation failures terminate the session. Record and lease consumption cannot be mixed. Strict record delivery validates each complete body and attachment CRC before reporting Success, but does not validate cross-record declaration references or establish full-file validation.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapAttachment
files.Summary: Owned attachment payload and fields. Times use caller-defined nanoseconds.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapAttachmentHeader
files.Summary: Attachment fields. LogTime and CreateTime use caller-defined nanoseconds.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapAttachmentIndex
files.Summary: Owned attachment index with byte Offset from the MCAP origin (the initial Stream position for Stream inputs) and record Length; DataSize counts payload bytes and times are nanoseconds.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapAttachmentRecord
files.Summary: Owned attachment body and stored CRC.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapBatchReadResult
files.Summary: A successful batch result. Count identifies valid header/range entries and BytesWritten the valid payload prefix. On BufferTooSmall, RequiredLength is the entire pending message payload size; retry preserves that message. No result is published on exception.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapBatchStopReason
files.Summary: Why a successful batch read or visit stopped; errors throw instead of returning this status.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapBatchWriteException
files.Summary: A failed batch may have written a prefix and part of its failing record.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapCacheStatistics
files.Summary: Cumulative snapshot diagnostics: Hits counts cache reuse and ChunkLoads counts actual chunk loads, including loads not retained by the cache. Not allocation or memory statistics.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapChannel
files.Summary: Resolved channel declaration with optional schema and metadata. Reader results own their data; direct construction retains supplied references.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapChannelDescription
files.Summary: Immutable resolved channel declaration shareable across messages and threads; survives reader disposal.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapChannelRecord
files.Summary: Owned channel record retaining the schema ID rather than resolving the schema object.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapChunkHeader
files.Summary: Chunk descriptor. Times are nanoseconds; sizes are bytes; UncompressedCrc covers expanded record bytes.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapChunkIndex
files.Summary: Owned chunk index. ChunkStartOffset and MessageIndexOffsets are byte offsets from the MCAP origin (the initial Stream position for Stream inputs); lengths and sizes are bytes; times are nanoseconds.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapChunkRecord
files.Summary: Owned chunk record. Data contains the compressed bytes described by Header.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapCompression
files.Summary: Compression codec used for chunks; None leaves record bytes uncompressed.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapCursorMode
files.Summary: Selects slice-parser semantics. Every mode supports record delivery; only RawMessages and Messages support message delivery.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapDataEnd
files.Summary: Data-section end marker containing its stored CRC.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapErrorKind
files.Summary: Structured MCAP or binding failure classification. Consult Details for kind-specific native fields; this is not a retry policy.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapException
files.Summary: A structured MCAP failure. Reader sessions normally become terminal; writer continuation is limited to CanContinueWriting.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapFooter
files.Summary: Footer fields: summary offsets are byte positions from the MCAP origin (the initial Stream position for Stream inputs); SummaryCrc is the stored summary checksum.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapFormat
files.Summary: Constants identifying the MCAP wire format and bundled upstream implementation.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapHeader
files.Summary: Owned file header containing the profile and writer library identifier.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapIndexSnapshot
files.Summary: Owns copied or explicitly mapped input and its official summary, independently of the originating session. Snapshot message callbacks must not invoke operations on any snapshot or prepared chunk index, including disposal.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapIndexSnapshotOptions
files.Summary: Limits only the snapshot cache, not upstream allocations or live leases.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapMessage
files.Summary: Message with resolved declarations and payload bytes. Reader results own independent data; direct construction retains supplied references. Times use caller-defined nanoseconds.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapMessageBatchLease
files.Summary: Owns stable native message storage. Keep this lease alive until all payload access has finished. Access and disposal must not overlap. Payload spans expire on disposal. A payload slice can retain an entire chunk, copied input or mapping; payload length is not retained capacity.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapMessageHeader
files.Summary: Message descriptor. LogTime and PublishTime are caller-defined nanoseconds; ChannelId refers to a declared channel.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapMessageIndex
files.Summary: Owned per-channel message index, including channels with an empty Records collection.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapMessageIndexEntry
files.Summary: Message log time in nanoseconds and byte offset within the uncompressed chunk record stream, not an offset from the MCAP origin.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapMessageLease
files.Summary: An independently retained message. Do not dispose concurrently with payload access.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapMessageRecord
files.Summary: Owned message record with an independent payload array.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapMessageVisitor
files.Summary: Consumes a borrowed payload synchronously. Return false to stop after this message. The span expires on return. Do not call back into the originating reader.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapMetadata
files.Summary: Owned named string metadata record.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapMetadataIndex
files.Summary: Owned metadata index with byte Offset from the MCAP origin (the initial Stream position for Stream inputs) and complete record Length in bytes.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapOpcode
files.Summary: Standard MCAP record opcodes. Private records use byte values 0x80-0xFF.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapPayloadRange
files.Summary: Byte offset and length within the payload storage passed to the same batch operation; not a file offset.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapPreparedChannel
files.Summary: An immutable native snapshot. Preparing does not register or write declarations.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapPreparedChunkIndex
files.Summary: An immutable, native-owned copy of a Chunk index for repeated operations across snapshots.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapPreparedOperation
files.Summary: Immutable owned descriptor prepared once for repeated control writes. Factories copy descriptor values and schema bytes; preparation does not register or write anything. Dispose after the last synchronous use.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapQuery
files.Summary: Message selection with inclusive StartTime and exclusive EndTime. Topic and Topics are mutually exclusive. A null query uses file order; an explicit query defaults to ascending log time.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapRawRecord
files.Summary: An independently owned opcode and unparsed record body. Data excludes the opcode and length prefix. Use McapRecords.Parse for typed fields.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapReadCursor
files.Summary: One disposable cursor over copied/mapped input, a summary, or a retained chunk. Adapts official slice-reader semantics. Construction copies input; advancement parses records. Unsupported message delivery is rejected without advancement or terminal failure. Summary cursors support records only; snapshot Chunk cursors support messages as well as records.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapReadEvent
files.Summary: A parser request or delivered item; interpret fields according to Kind, not merely a successful read status.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapReadEventKind
files.Summary: Discriminates parser input requests, delivered records and completion.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapReadOrder
files.Summary: Message traversal ordering; equal log-time ordering is unspecified.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapReadSession
files.Summary: Owns one native reader. Calls are serialized and cannot be reentered from Stream callbacks.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapReadStatus
files.Summary: Outcome of a caller-buffer read or Sans-I/O event poll. Success describes availability, not a particular MCAP opcode.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapReaderFactory
files.Summary: Reusable reader factory with instance methods for a file path and static methods for Streams; construction validates the path but does not open the file. This factory owns no disposable resources. Each opened session or enumeration owns an independent native reader and its input.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapReaderOptions
files.Summary: Parsing and integrity options for one read session. Defaults do not prove full-file integrity; a strict complete expanded McapReadSession scan provides full-file validation. Adapter-specific validation scopes are described by Strict.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapRecordFields
files.Summary: Allocation-free typed field cursor. Length-prefixed collections can be traversed with another cursor.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapRecordMode
files.Summary: Whether sequential record scans expose chunks or expand their contents.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapRecordReadResult
files.Summary: Caller-buffer read outcome. On Success, Opcode identifies the record and Length is the body bytes copied; on BufferTooSmall, Length is the required capacity and the same record remains pending. EOF does not prove full-file integrity.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapRecordView
files.Summary: A record body validated at Parse time over caller-owned memory. Keep the underlying bytes unchanged for the entire lifetime of this view and all derived field cursors or spans. Read-only spans do not prevent mutation through other aliases. UTF-8 and collection fields remain borrowed spans; ToOwned creates an independent copy.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapRecords
files.Summary: Parses record bodies into independent owned models and exposes MCAP layout helpers.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapRecoveryResult
files.Summary: Result of explicit prefix salvage. IsFullyValidated is true only after a strict complete scan; Error describes the failure that ended salvage, if any.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapSansIoReader
files.Summary: Caller-driven official Rust parser. No I/O or borrowed native memory is exposed. Positions are measured from the MCAP origin; when servicing requests on a Stream containing a prefix, translate between these positions and the Stream position using its initial MCAP position.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapSchema
files.Summary: Schema declaration. Reader results own independent mutable schema bytes; direct construction retains the supplied array.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapSchemaDescription
files.Summary: An immutable declaration snapshot that can be shared across messages and threads.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapSeekRequest
files.Summary: One random message lookup. Index must remain undisposed during the call; Entry.Offset is relative to expanded chunk bytes.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapStatistics
files.Summary: Owned summary statistics. Message times are nanoseconds; counts describe the recorded data section.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapSummary
files.Summary: Summary model. Library-returned snapshots own independent collections; direct construction retains supplied references. Size grows with file indexes and declarations.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapSummaryOffset
files.Summary: Summary group descriptor with byte start from the MCAP origin (the initial Stream position for Stream inputs) and byte length.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapSummaryReaderOptions
files.Summary: Options for direct Sans-I/O summary reading. FileSize permits end-relative seeks to be resolved against the caller-provided source length.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapVisitResult
files.Summary: Number of completed visitor calls and why traversal stopped. VisitorStopped includes the message whose callback returned false; callback exceptions publish no result.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapWriter
files.Summary: A serialized MCAP writer. Complete explicitly to finish the format; disposal only releases resources. Native or I/O failures are terminal except for configured audited pre-mutation rejections.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapWriterOptions
files.Summary: Writer configuration fixed at construction. Null emission/CRC switches retain upstream settings; other nullable settings have the semantics documented on their properties. Input payloads are consumed synchronously; Complete must be called explicitly.

files.Title: Fizzy.McapSharp.McapWriterSafeRejections
files.Summary: Audited pre-mutation native rejections that may leave the writer usable. I/O and cleanup failures remain terminal.
